items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTY1NDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--706ac75f6cf6972bc1df69e20afd1af3fd228aca/Todo%20o%20nada%20San%20Andr%C3%A9s%20Cholula%202025_500.png) ​ ##### Español ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ¡Bienvenidos a **Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025**! Cholula, sus 37 iglesias y sus aires prehispánicos están listos para recibirte en esta nueva competencia. Tendrás una sola ronda para demostrar por que eres el mejor. Cada segundo y resolución será decisiva desde el primer intento. ¿Tienes lo que se necesita para ser el más rápido? ¡Acepta el reto y gira hacia la victoria! Esto es, **¡Todo o Nada!** Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Municipo de **"San Andrés Cholula"** y a la Presidenta Municipal **Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**. Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 20215 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ ##### English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to **Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025**! Cholula, with its 37 churches and pre-Hispanic spirit, is ready to welcome you to this new competition. You’ll have just one round to prove why you’re the best. Every second and every solve will be decisive from the very first attempt. Do you have what it takes to be the fastest? Take the challenge and twist your way to victory! This is All or Nothing! This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the Municipality of **San Andrés Cholula** and **Municipal President Guadalupe Cuautle Torres.** Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTIyOTYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c8e7880920b71a70254e01ebbfdca580b90e8b0c/cubo_azul_con_fondo-01.png) **¡Vuelven los Big Cubes a Guadalajara!** Despues de casi dos años desde la ultima vez **Cubo Azul Guadalajara 2025** cuenta con *3 rondas de todas las categorías NxN.* El nombre de la competencia hace alusión al Parque Agua Azul, cercano a la sede del evento, además referenciamos al mariposario de este mismo parque en el logo de la competencia. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) antes de la competencia. **¡Big cubes are back to Guadalajara!** After almost two years since the last time, **Cubo Azul Guadalajara 2025** has *3 rounds of every NxN event*. The name of the competition is inspired by the park Parque Agua Azul, located near the event venue. The competition logo also references the park’s butterfly house. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODA3MjgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--5867375aec6a04a78bbf775d04473f088a028f10/Swiss%20Nationals%20V3%20Logo.png) [*DE*] Da dies die offizielle Speedcubing Schweizer-Meisterschaft ist, qualifizieren sich die jeweils besten 12 Schweizer der vorherigen Runde sowie alle Teilnehmer anderer Nationalitäten dazwischen für die jeweiligen Finals. [*EN*] As these are the official Swiss Speedcubing Championship, the best 12 Swiss competitors of the previous round as well as all participants of other nationalities in between qualify for the respective finals.

Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$20. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- ## English Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](link da página de inscrições da sua competição) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R$20. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025! ### This competition is open to everyone to compete in, regardless of nationality or experience level. [![Kewbz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1Y0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3fb56d1f073b7544d2cf011acfe92e29f237f69/Kewbz_Logo.png)](https://ukspeedcubes.co.uk/) ![Scottish Championship Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQyNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c4ab4fd8fb34605abb30bab45291a8318375f865/Scottish%20Champs%20Logo.png) #### New Competitors: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52598-faq) and the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52599-important-information) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. #### Free T-Shirt: By registering and attending Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025, you'll receive a free Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025 T-shirt! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size. A sizing guide is provided in the** [T-Shirt tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52603-t-shirt-sizes). #### Qualifications: **3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Skewb, Pyraminx, and 3x3 One-Handed do not have any qualification requirements and remain open to everyone, including new competitors, to compete in**. Other events have qualification requirements in place. If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025/#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by May 19th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. #### Spectators and Guests: Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There is no need to pre-book. #### Prizes: As this is the Kewbz Scottish Championship, **only competitors who are Scottish** (please see the [prizes eligiblity tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#53036-prizes-eligibility) for further details) **will be eligible for prizes**. The competition remains open for competitors of all nationalities and UK regions to compete. #### Podium Positions: If fewer than three Scottish competitors proceed to the final of an event, any remaining podium positions will be determined using the results of the highest ranked Scottish competitors in the previous round. #### Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025: The Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025 will be held separately on Saturday 24th May in Glasgow. This competition will host 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3 Fewest Moves. Podiummers at the Blind Off will be crowned at Kewbz Scottish Championship. #### Invitation Letters: Should you need a Visa invitation letter, or a note from us to help authorise time off school, please [get in touch](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition). #### Media Enquiries: Please [contact us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition) for all media enquiries.

items.name: Kölner Kubing 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDIwOTUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7a09c07e7df2145faa8d4f7db972b8360df44444/KK25_New.png) ##### **German** Willkommen zurück beim Zauberwürfel Wettbewerb in Köln! Zum dritten Mal findet Kölner Kubing statt. Seid dabei, knackt eure Rekorde, egal ob Einsteiger oder Profi – habt Spaß an diesem Turnier. Schnappt euch euren Würfel und seid Teil dieses einzigartigen Events! **Wichtig!** Bei den letzten Competitions von Köln hatten wir in den ersten 5 Minuten über 150 Anmeldungen. Sorgt bitte dafür, dass ihr die Teilnahmegebühr **vor** der Online-Anmeldung bezahlt. Wenn Ihr überweisen müsst, macht das bitte 2-3 Tage vorher, damit die Zahlung rechtzeitig bei uns ankommt. Wir gehen wieder davon aus, dass auch Kölner Kubing 2025 innerhalb weniger Minuten voll sein wird! **English** Welcome back to the Rubik's Cube competition in Cologne! Kölner Kubing is taking place for the third time. Be there, break your records, whether you are a beginner or a pro - have fun at this tournament. Grab your cube and be part of this unique event! **Important!** In the last competitions in Cologne we had over 150 registrations in the first 5 minutes. Please make sure that you pay the entry fee **before** you register online. If you have to pay by bank transfer, please do so 2-3 days in advance so that we receive the payment in time. We assume that Kölner Kubing 2025 will again be full within a few minutes!

Será um prazer recebê-los. **VEJA AS ATUALIZAÇÕES DA COMPETIÇÃO NO NOSSO INSTAGRAM** **@riocubolympics** Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. It will be a pleasure to welcome you. **SEE THE UPDATES OF THE COMPETITIONS ON OUR INSTAGRAM** **@riocubolympics** Tips: - Arrive at the competition location at least 30 minutes before the category you will participate in; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers. Have a lot of fun!

Si vous mettez les deux, votre inscription ne sera pas acceptée. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. --- ### [EN] Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule). **ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, write your email address ending with etsmtl.net in the registration comments and submit your registration **without paying the registration fee**. **You may not register for both 5x5 blindfolded and megaminx**. You must choose at most one of the two. If you put both, your registration will not be accepted. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

The first ever state championship held in Nevada! The competition is open to all, but only Nevada residents are eligible for state champion titles. See NV Champion Eligibility for more info. * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. #### **How to Withdraw/Alter Registration** Registered competitors withdraw/alter their registration by emailing the organisation team (unrcubing@gmail.com) the following: 1. Statement of intent to withdraw/alter registration. 2. Changes to registration (if applicable). 3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor. #### **Staff Member Registration** Competition staff members are hand-selected by the organisation team and will be offered a refunded registration fee in exchange for their service to the cubing community for the entire duration of the competition. For this competition all staff members must fill out the form in the Staff Applications tab. If you do not fill out this form you will not be able to staff this competition.

venue.address: R. Camões, 601 - Alto da XV, Curitiba - PR, 80045-320

items.information: **PORTUGUÊS** Sejam todos bem-vindos à segunda competição no Alto da XV Mall em parceria com o Capivara! Essa competição terá como foco os "big cubes", portanto teremos tempos de corte generosos para que todos possam participar e se divertir. Também teremos premiação extra-oficial para as mulheres e os iniciantes melhores colocados na modalidade 3x3x3. Nesta competição estamos arrecadando doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Todo o lucro da competição será revertido para esta campanha. Para mais informações, consulte a aba Campanha Beneficente. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, pois penalidades serão aplicadas rigorosamente de acordo com ele. O regulamento pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Lembre-se de estar **pelo menos meia hora antes** de cada rodada que for participar e de fazer seu credenciamento no momento que chegar! **ENGLISH** Welcome to the second competition at Alto da XV Mall in partnership with Capivara! This competition is going to have a focus on "big cubes", so we will have generous cutoff times so everyone can participate and have fun. We will also have unofficial awards to the best women and newcomers in the 3x3x3 event. In this competition we are collecting donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. All profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. For more information, check the Charitable Campaign tab. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA). It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. The regulations can be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Remember to be at the venue at least **thirty minutes before** each event you will participate and to check in at the moment you arrive!

items.information: **Deutsch** Herzlich Willkommen zur **Rahn Education Open 2025** in Leipzig Nach den ersten beiden Competitions 2023 und 2024 sowie den Rubik's German Nationals 2024 können wir **Leipzig** nun zu einem etablierten Cubing-Standort zählen. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet wieder eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr. Diese Ausgabe der **Rahn Education Open** im Rahmen des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month richtet sich an neue und unerfahrene Cuber. Bei der Anmeldung werden deshalb 43,75% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmende reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmende gelten Teilnehmende ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2025. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmende haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2024 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmenden müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. We, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. Once again, you can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig, a motivated organizing team and much more. This edition of the **Rahn Education Open** as part of the official WCA Newcomer Month is aimed at new and inexperienced cubers. When registering, 43.75% of the places will therefore be reserved for new participants. Participants without a WCA ID or with a WCA ID from the year 2025 are considered new participants. Returning participants have a WCA ID from the year 2024 or earlier. All participants must continue to fulfill all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. You can find more information on how registrations are accepted in the “Newcomer Month” tab. **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM0NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7f38aa440f2f5ea4ba0f22de16d4f6cdf4c47946/IMG-20250124-WA0034.jpg) ​ ##### Español ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ¡Bienvenidos a **Mega-Mente Puebla 2025**! Puebla se prepara para recibirte en un torneo que pondrá a prueba tus habilidades y conocimientos. **¿Qué tan lejos puede llegar tu mente?** El nombre del torneo y nuestra categoría principal no son coincidencia. Cada detalle ha sido pensado para resaltar la conexión entre la fuerza mental y el desafío que representa este evento. El Megaminx, con su forma dodecaédrica, representa un verdadero desafío para la mente, exigiendo combinar estrategia, eficiencia, precisión, visión espacial y velocidad. Así es como Megaminx se convierte en el corazón de este torneo, acompañado de otras categorías desafiantes que pondrán a prueba tu mente. Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2025 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ ##### English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to **Mega-Mente Puebla 2025**! Puebla is ready to welcome you to a tournament that will challenge your knowledge and skills. **How far can your mind go?** The name of the tournament and our main category are no coincidence. Every detail has been carefully designed to highlight the connection between mental strength and the challenge this event represents. The Megaminx, with its dodecahedral shape, embodies a true mental challenge, demanding a combination of strategy, efficiency, precision, spatial awareness, and speed. This is why the Megaminx becomes the heart of this tournament, accompanied by other challenging categories that will put your mind to the test. This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Mega-Mind Puebla 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information: ### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다. ### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/56/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/56/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/56/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/56/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.information: (SRB) Battle For Belgrade 2025 je dvadeset i treće po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. **Ovo takmičenje će se razlikovati od uobičajenih takmičenja koja smo do sada organizovali. Takmičari će biti podeljeni u 2 tima i zajedno će pokušati da ostvare što veći broj poena da bi osvojili nagrade. Pročitajte detaljnije o konceptu takmičenja** [ovde.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BattleForBelgrade2025#52904-battle-for-belgrade-koncept-battle-for-belgrade-concept) ------------------------ (ENG) Battle For Belgrade 2025 is the 23rd speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. **This competition will be different from the ones we are usually organizing. Competitors will be divided into 2 teams, and will work together to try and achieve as many points as possible. Read more about the competition's concept** [here.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BattleForBelgrade2025#52904-battle-for-belgrade-koncept-battle-for-belgrade-concept)

items.information: ##Português: **Competidores, atenção aos seguintes avisos:** - Esta competição *não terá a modalidade* ***3x3x3*** ; - Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização**; - O competidor poderá se inscrever antecipadamente pelo site e sua inscrição será confirmada apenas com o pagamento da taxa via PIX: **fbgrac@gmail.com**, após isso enviar comprovante para o mesmo e-mail, contendo o print do comprovante e o nome do competidor. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **Caso o limite de 28 competidores não seja atingido, estaremos aceitando inscrições no local pelo preço de R$21, por ordem de chegada** ##English: **Competitors, heed the following warnings:** - This competition *will NOT have* the ***3x3x3*** event; - This competition will have a limit on competitors. Register only if you are **sure that you will participate**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization**; - The competitor may register in advance on the website and their registration will only be confirmed upon payment of the fee via PIX: **fbgrac@gmail.com**, after which send proof of registration to the same email, containing the print of the proof of registration and the name of the competitor. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara! Desde o ano passados, estamos trabalhando com doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Estamos trabalhando em conjunto com o [LEO e Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) para arrecadar brinquedos e alimentos para crianças carentes, então todo o lucro da competição será revertido para essa campanha. Além disso, se você quiser fazer uma doação no dia, também será muito bem-vinda. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** It is in great excitement that we announce a new Capivara! Starting last year, we are working with donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. We are working together with [LEO and Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) to collect toys and food to children in need, so all profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. Besides that, if you would like to give a donation on the spot, it will also be very welcome. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=6Yf5Zun_nlTfECTy). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **English** The love for cubes goes beyond just solving a puzzle; it's a passion that challenges the mind, sharpens focus, and brings together people who share the same enthusiasm. At the Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024 competition, we invite you to be part of this unique experience, where you'll not only test your skill and speed but also share unforgettable moments with a vibrant community of cubers. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition.

items.name: Norrlandsmästerskapet 2024
items.information: Välkomna till Norrlandsmästerskapet 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Norrland som kan vinna titlar och priser på Norrlandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Norrlandsmasterskapet2024#43369-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". ----- Welcome to Norrlandsmästerskapet 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Norrland can win titles and prizes at the Norrland Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Norrlandsmasterskapet2024#43369-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". items.information: Els socis de l'ACSC reben un descompte del 15% després de la competició. Pots fer-te soci de l'ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Aquesta competició no té una categoria principal. El guanyador de la competició es decidirà mitjançant el “Sum of Ranks”. Això consisteix a sumar totes les posicions en què ha quedat un competidor a totes les categories, i qui obtingui el nombre més baix serà qui millor ha actuat en tot el llarg de la competició i, per tant, el guanyador. ​ Los socios de la ACSC reciben un descuento del 15% después de la competición. Puedes hacerte socio de la ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Esta competición no tiene una categoría principal. El ganador de la competición se decidirá mediante “Sum of Ranks”. Esto consiste a sumar todas las posiciones en que ha quedado un competidor en todas las categorías, y quién obtenga el número más bajo será quien mejor ha actuado a lo largo de toda la competición y, por tanto, el ganador. ​ The ACSC members will receive a 15% discount after the end of the competition. You can become a member of the ACSC [here](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). This competition does not have a main event. The winner of the competition will be decided through the “Sum of Ranks”. This consists of adding all the positions in which a competitor has remained in all categories, and the one who obtain the lowest number will be the one who has performed best throughout the competition and, therefore, the winner.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2024
items.information: ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2024! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#41928-guests-spectators-and-media) tab. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2024, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2024 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Guests:** A fee of £5 for a guest wristband will be due for all spectators and competitors' guests. They will be available on the door, payable via cash or card. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** Please note that the guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only. **Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by October 22nd you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.** **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1: 6 UK competitors; 3x3: 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2024). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2024. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbng5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--153ecb54fb75b7956c0701cb174dca72201b0444/image.png)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzcxNjYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--62c69d32ea5b4a05a0c37f03abac9aab2f2a15c5/OP1.jpg) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Nayarit Open 2024, una competencia más en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días 26 y 27 de octubre de 2024. El Nayarit Open 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo Nayarit y de otras regiones, ofreciéndoles la oportunidad de demostrar sus habilidades y competir en todos los eventos NxN. Ya seas un principiante o un experto con experiencia, este torneo brinda una ocasión única para que todos participen, disfruten y vivan la emoción de la competencia. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to the Nayarit Open 2024, another exciting competition in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This thrilling and fast-paced event will take place in the city of Tepic on October 26 and 27, 2024. The Nayarit Open 2024 will bring together cubers from all over Nayarit and beyond, offering them the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in all NxN events. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced expert, this tournament provides a unique chance for everyone to participate, have fun, and experience the excitement of competition. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association (WCA). Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 – Астанадағы 24 сағаттық ашық жарыс. Бұл жарыстар 24 сағат үзіліссіз өтеді, сондықтан олар жас және жаңа қатысушыларға ұсынылмайды. Кез келген пәндер санына қатысу мүмкіндігімен базалық жарна 3000 теңгені құрайды. 1 кез келген пәнге тіркелу кезінде тіркеу жарнасы 1000 теңгені құрайды. Бұл жарыстарды QBERS TEAM ұйымдастырады. 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 - это первые открытые 24-х часовые соревнования в Астане. Данные соревнования будут проходить без перерывов 24 часа, следовательно не рекомендуются для юных и новых участников. Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 3000 тенге. При регистрации на 1 любую дисциплину регистрационный взнос составит 1000 тенге. Данные сореванования организованы QBERS TEAM. 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 is the first open 24-hour competition in Astana. These competitions will take place without breaks for 24 hours, therefore they are not recommended for young and new participants. The base registration fee for any number of events is 3000 tenge. If you're participating in 1 event only, the registration fee is 1000 tenge. These competition is organized by QBERS TEAM.

items.name: Championnat Québécois 2024
items.information: ### [FR] Il s'agit du tout premier championnat québécois organisé par [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org). 13 épreuves officielles de la WCA (toutes les épreuves sauf 4x4x4 à l'aveugle, 5x5x5 à l'aveugle ,3x3x3 Multi-Blind, et 3x3x3 Fewest Moves) seront organisées lors de cette compétition. **Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**. Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, inscrivez votre courriel finissant par estmtl.net dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis **ne payez pas les frais d'inscription**. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. --- ### [EN] This is the first-ever Quebec Championship organized by [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org). 13 official WCA events (all events except 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3x3 Fewest Moves) will be held at this competition. **ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, write your email address ending with etsmtl.net in the registration comments and submit your registration **and do not pay the registration fees**. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Swiss Nationals 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdWg4IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4db84498fca6a7c2e9ba0d4f67075bcc1a731589/Flyer%20Querformat.png) [DE] Bitte gebe bei der Anmeldung im Bemerkungsfeld an, ob du ein T-Shirt für die Swiss Nationals kaufen möchtest oder nicht. Wenn du ein T-Shirt kaufen möchtest, gib uns bitte deine grösse an und ob du ein T-Shirt in weiss oder cardinal-rot möchtest. Vor Ort wird es nur eine sehr geringe, limitierte Anzahl T-shirts zu kaufen geben. Die Kosten für das T-Shirt betragen: CHF 25.00. Die kosten sind bei der Registration zu begleichen. Wir müssen die T-Shirts bis zum 08.09.2024 vorbestellen. [EN] When registering, please indicate in the comments field whether you would like to buy a T-shirt for the Swiss Nationals or not. If you would like to buy a T-shirt, please let us know your size and if you want the T-shirt in white or cardinal-red. There will only be a very small, limited number of T-shirts available for purchase on site. The cost of the T-shirt is: CHF 25.00. You will pay the T-shirt at the registration desk. We must pre-order the T-shirts by 08.09.2024. [*DE*] Da dies die offizielle Speedcubing Schweizer-Meisterschaft ist, qualifizieren sich die jeweils besten 12 Schweizer der vorherigen Runde sowie alle Teilnehmer anderer Nationalitäten dazwischen für die jeweiligen Finals. [*EN*] As these are the official Swiss Speedcubing Championship, the best 12 Swiss competitors of the previous round as well as all participants of other nationalities in between qualify for the respective finals.

items.name: Sandnes Open 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 170kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Sandnes Open 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 170 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

items.name: Örebro Minxfest 2024
items.information: Välkomna till en tävling i Örebro med ett fokus på sidogrenar! Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Tre försök av FMC kommer att hållas under morgonen fram till lunch, så om du inte deltar i FMC behöver du inte komma till lokalen förrens lunch. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to a competition in Örebro with a focus on side events! Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. Three attempts of FMC will be held during the morning up until lunch, so you don't have to come to the venue before lunch if you're not participating in FMC. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.

Para 7 o más categorías, el precio es de $450. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FatimaenMontevideo2024#46196-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FatimaenMontevideo2024#46197-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full#2l1). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación de la categoría, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full#2u) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia. Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA. *** # ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHBIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bacb00caed7d0c9177dc3ea7d687667b270ce30d/6i.png) English Competitor limit: **60**. * The base entry fee for up to 6 events is $UYU 350. For 7 or more events the entry fee is $UYU 450. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FatimaenMontevideo2024#46196-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FatimaenMontevideo2024#46197-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full#2l1). * Competitors must bring their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * It is important to read all the information available in the competition website. items.name: BC Championship 2024
items.information: After hosting the Canadian Championship in July 2023, Speedcubing Canada welcomes you back for BC's first Provincial Championship! Note: While everybody is welcome to attend and compete, only BC residents will be eligible for the title of **BC Champion**. For more information, please check out the [Championship Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2024#41375-championship-eligibility). **Please review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up for longer. So, if you are not competing in any events being held on Friday, then you don't need to show up until Saturday. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so please be ready for each event/round **about 30 minutes in advance**, just in-case. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time. [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdWh2IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f989abe60a5b9303f42de97dee94ad812338f4b3/image.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/en) **Notice of filming and photography**: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. Masks will be optional. Do not attend if you feel/are sick.

items.name: Norwegian Championship 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHFKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c60c36a3fbfb1c2f2d10ce4665856be2a51bbe19/Artboard%201.png) ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2024, for første gang holdt i Sandnes! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). ### Staffing Vi kommer til å trenge frivillige som kan bidra med ulike oppgaver under arrangementet. De som bidrar på dette teamet vil få ulike goder, blant annet refundert registreringsavgift. Les [Staffing-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) for mer info. --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2024, held in Sandnes for the first time. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab. ### Staffing We are going to need volunteers to help with different tasks during the competition. Those who chose to be a part of this team will get perks such as a refunded registration fee. Read the [Staffing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) tab for more info.

items.information: Chào mừng các bạn đến với giải đấu vô địch quốc gia Vietnam Championship 2024! Giải Vietnam Championship lần này sẽ có toàn bộ các bộ môn thi đấu, với nhiều môn thi đấu có từ 2 đến 4 vòng. Xem thêm thông tin tại các tab. # Điều kiện tham dự thi Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5 Các thí sinh tham dự các nội dung **Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5** phải đạt điều kiện sau: * Thí sinh phải có **ít nhất một lượt** Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 thành công. * Kết quả Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 tốt nhất của thí sinh đạt **Top 20** trong số các thí sinh đã đăng ký thi nội dung tương ứng. Các thí sinh không đạt những điều kiện này sẽ **không được tham dự thi** các nội dung tương ứng và sẽ được hoàn 100% lệ phí các môn này (nếu đã nộp). # Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các hãng truyền thông tại giải đấu có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Bằng cách có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu. ________________________________________________________________ We warmly welcome you to Vietnam Championships 2024! This year's Vietnam Championship will offer all events, many of which will be offering 2 to 4 rounds. Refer to the tabs for more information. # Qualification Criteria for 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded Competitors in **4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded** must meet the following qualification criteria: * The competitor must have **at least one** successful 3x3x3 Blindfolded result. * The competitor's best 3x3x3 Blindfolded result must be within the **Top 20** of all registered competitors of the respective event. Competitors who fail to meet these criteria will **not be allowed to compete in the respective event** and will receive a full refund of any event fees for the events (if already paid). # Notice on Filming and Photography The organizers and/or present media companies may perform filming and photography at the competition for usage as photographic material of the competition. By being present at the competition premises, **you acknowledge that you have been duly informed of any filming and photography that might take place at the competition, and fully acknowledge that the material may be used for any and all necessary purposes by the Vietnam Cube Association (VNCA) and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors. You also grant full, perpetual consent for VNCA and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors to use video and photographic material that contains your likeness and/or voice for any and all necessary purposes.** If you do not agree with the above terms, please do not be present at the competition premises. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBclJwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2901c91547887dda589a7979741476bc143c0896/vietnamcube%20(1).png)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbzU1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2bf71d7090c7cef300fb39fb94a81e1b8389c08d/Page%202.png) Cube Together je sice soutěž, hlavně to však má být také setkání všech nadšenců Rubikových kostek bez ohledu na věk, schopnosti a ostatní zájmy atd., prostě pro všechny 😊 Pokud máte doma nějaké kostky, co už moc nepoužíváte a chtěli byste je poslat dále (prodat), na soutěži bude v polední pauze pro toto prostor 😉! items.name: 24 Hours in Åker 2024
items.information: Varmt välkomna till denna 24-timmarstävling i Åkers Styckebruk! Precis som vanligt så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta, men vi vill ändå utfärda en kraftig varning kring att tävlingen pågår nonstop i just 24 timmar, och har ett väldigt speciellt koncept. Därför passar tävlingen sannolikt inte varken nya eller yngre deltagare särskilt bra. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information, särskilt fliken [koncept](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/24HoursinAker2024#43667-koncept-concept). ----- A warm welcome to this 24-hour competition in Åkers Styckebruk! Just as usual, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate, but we still want to issue a strong warning that the competition runs non-stop for exactly 24 hours, and has a very special concept. Therefore, the competition probably does not suit neither new or younger participants very well. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information, especially the [concept tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/24HoursinAker2024#43667-koncept-concept). [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnRyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6168ff3debe6e6fb0d390d1aee873034e58c6840/Untitled-4%20(1).webp) **Please Note:** As this is Ireland's National Championship, only competitors who represent Ireland will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. **Free T-Shirt** All registered competitors will receive a free t-shirt. items.name: Oslo Open 2024
items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2024! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

items.information: ## Information [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Big & Blind Pretoria 2024! If any competitor or competitor's guest is willing to help judge with the blind events, especially multi-blind, please let us know. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Summer 2024 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner, Pranjal Khan und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Summer 2024 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner, Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

Será um prazer recebê-los. **Dicas:** - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos **30 minutos** antes de **modalidade que participará**; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! ### ENGLISH Welcome to **Rio Cubolympics 2024**! It will be a pleasure to welcome you. **Tips:** - Arrive at the competition location at least **30 minutes** before **the category you will participate in**; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers. Have a lot of fun!

items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 3-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 3-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

items.information: Välkomna till den första tävlingen någonsin i Örebro! Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Detta är också en utmärkt möjlighet att delta på [FMC-SM](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024), som hålls dagen efter och det finns möjlighet att tävla i Örebro. Däremot är platserna begränsade till sju deltagare, så anmäl dig snarast om du är sugen! Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to the first competition ever in Örebro! Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. This is also an excellent opportunity to participate in the [Swedish FMC Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024) which is held the day after, and it's possible to compete in Örebro. There is however a 7-person limit, so make sure to grab a spot soon if you're interested! We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. **ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores! --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events. **ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors!

items.name: Big Cubes Athens 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0ZpIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d2ad4e4f29cfeee447dd4662438ee1c08da476ee/image.png) Mετά τη συναρπαστική πορεία του 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' η δράση συνεχίζεται με τον επόμενο διαγωνισμό της σειράς, αυτή τη φορά με έμφαση στα μεγάλα παζλ! Καλωσορίζουμε τους παίκτες στο δεύτερο μέρος αυτής της συναρπαστικής περιπέτειας, όπου τα παζλ υψηλής δυσκολίας θα κλέψουν την παράσταση. Από τon 4x4x4, μέχρι τoν 7x7x7. Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι σχεδιασμένος να δοκιμάσει τις δεξιότητες και την υπομονή των πιο έμπειρων cubers. Μην χάσετε την ευκαιρία να δείτε και να συμμετάσχετε σε αυτό το θέαμα δεξιοτεχνίας και αντοχής, όπου το μέγεθος και η πολυπλοκότητα πραγματικά μετράνε. Ετοιμάστε τους κύβους σας για μια ακόμα πρόκληση στον κόσμο του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) After the exciting run of 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' the action continues with the next competition in the series, this time with an emphasis on big puzzles! We welcome players to the second part of this thrilling adventure, where high-difficulty puzzles will steal the show. From the impressive 4x4x4s to the complex 7x7x7s and other equally challenging sizes, this competition is designed to test the skills and patience of the most experienced cubers. Don't miss the opportunity to witness and participate in this spectacle of dexterity and endurance, where size and complexity truly matter. Prepare your cubes for another challenge in the world of cubing! Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.name: DFW Megacomp 2024
items.information: This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **New competitors registration will be accepted based on the following:** * The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If greater than 25% of new competitors register, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If less than 25% of new competitors register before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following:** * The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If 25% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis. * If 25% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. --- As the month of March is WCA Newcomer Month, 25% of the competitor limit will be reserved for first-time competitors or competitors who's first competition is in 2024. More information can be found on the [WCA Newcomer Month tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#36408-wca-newcomer-month). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGhZIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--392ac2f0728e8e69ef497494e33b38b6b56bc2f4/565a7d59-6eb6-4b27-af6a-ad3bd4963ec0.png) # ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.*** - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#35850-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.
